mapper.sql: id, form_code as formCode, form_name as formName, audit, submit_limit as submitLimit, need_captcha as needCaptcha, success_tip as successTip, notify_email as notifyEmail, status, create_time as createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_form (id, form_code, form_name, audit, submit_limit, need_captcha, success_tip, notify_email, status, create_time) values (#{id}, #{formCode}, #{formName}, #{audit}, #{submitLimit}, #{needCaptcha}, #{successTip}, #{notifyEmail}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.sql: id, form_id as formId, field_code as fieldCode, field_name as fieldName, field_type as fieldType, required, default_value as defaultValue, placeholder, options, sort
mapper.insert: insert into fly_form_field (id, form_id, field_code, field_name, field_type, required, default_value, placeholder, options, sort) values (#{id}, #{formId}, #{fieldCode}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldType}, #{required}, #{defaultValue}, #{placeholder}, #{options}, #{sort})
mapper.sql: d.id, d.form_id as formId, d.user_id as userId, d.ip, d.data_json as dataJson, d.status, d.create_time as createTime, f.form_code as formCode, f.form_name as formName
mapper.insert: insert into fly_form_data (id, form_id, user_id, ip, data_json, status, create_time) values (#{id}, #{formId}, #{userId}, #{ip}, #{dataJson}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update fly_form_data set status=#{status} where id=#{id}
mapper.select:
select from fly_form_data d left join fly_form f on f.id = d.form_id
order by d.id desc limit #{offset},#{rows}
select count(1) from fly_form_data d left join fly_form f on f.id = d.form_id
select count(1) from fly_form_data where form_id=#{formId} and ip=#{ip} and create_time >= #{since}
select count(1) from fly_form_data where form_id=#{formId} and user_id=#{userId} and create_time >= #{since}
